text:
Priya: T-45 until the canary window for feature/route-bubble. Quick seatbelt checklist and who is on-hand? Targeting 20:00 UTC. Ping owners.
Jake: On-call for canary smoke. I'll watch logs and latency. Will be at my laptop by 19:50 UTC.
Carmen: I'll run the smoke suite and the KV cache checks. Posting quick checklist here:
```
- [ ] Verify canary model variant is v2.1-q4
- [ ] Confirm KV cache primed for top 100 prefixes
- [ ] Run latency smoke: /smoke --suite=core,kv-cache,latency
- [ ] Confirm no schema/db migrations enabled
```
release-bot: Deploy queued: build#5123 -> canary lane. Preflight checks started.
Alex: Rollback plan: revert to build#5088 (v1.2.3), disable route-bubble flag if 5xx > 1% or p95 latency +200ms sustained >3m. No DB schema changes.
Priya: Approvals needed: @Jake @Carmen please ack when ready. Also need QA owner for structured-output regression check.
Sam: QA on deck. Will run regen set (~100 prompts) and validate structured outputs. Expect results ~20:05 UTC.
Jake: Acked. Monitoring dashboard pinned and alert thresholds set: 5xx > 0.5% OR p95 latency increase >200ms. I added a short playbook in the dashboard notes.
Carmen: Smoke run on staging completed, all green. KV cache hit-rate 92% and tail latencies within baseline.
Sam: QA samples initial: 50/50 pass, 2 minor formatting diffs (not blocking). Posting diffs to #qa-samples.
Priya: Good. Roll window opens 20:00 UTC. Plan: 1% canary -> observe 10m -> 5% -> observe 15m -> continue ramp if green. Jake start canary at 20:00; Carmen run smoke checks; Sam validate outputs.
Jake: :thumbsup: kicking off canary now. Command I'm running:
```
redwood deploy --lane=canary --build=5123 --tag=route-bubble-canary
```
release-bot: Canary started. TaskID: cb-9876. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/tasks/cb-9876
Carmen: Confirming initial traffic routing: 1% split active. No errors in first 2 minutes, tail p99 latency stable.
Sam: QA full pass now on sample set. LGTM to ramp to 5%. Posted summary in thread.
Jake: Ramping to 5% now. Watching metrics closely.
Priya: Thanks all — if any alert fires, call rollback immediately. If stable, I'll mark ramp approved after the 15m observation window. Thanks team :rocket:
